title: Roster Candidates Response
description: PROV-06 typed payload for GET /recognition/clusters/{cluster_id}/roster-candidates. Candidates are labelled clusters; PHP maps cluster_id to roster_entry_id.

model_id.description: Embedding-space identifier that produced the ranking scores.

embedding_model.description: Same space as model_id; repeated so consumers can bind FIR23-01 without guessing.

computed_at.description: When this ranking was computed. Similarity is not a stable person attribute.

reference_face_count.description: Number of probe representatives used in the comparison.

candidates.description: Server-ranked labelled clusters. Order is similarity descending.

similarity.description: Ranking cosine only; not a calibrated probability.

roster_entry_id.description: Local acx_persons.id filled by the WordPress passthrough; absent on the python wire.
